item.title: Hubble 2.0.0
item.description:
# Hubble 2.0
Hubble 2.0 updates your existing Hubble and HubDash installation. Your saved workspaces, service settings, and Companion connections stay in place. Existing Companion buttons, actions, and feedback use the same protocol and do not need to be recreated. The separate Hubble2 and HubDash2 names are for development; the release keeps the Hubble and HubDash names.
- Device and workspace modules now have independent versions and releases. The initial 14 official modules are version 1.0.0, independently of the Hubble app's 2.0 version. A new module release no longer requires an application update. - Add module brings installed modules, available downloads, and custom-package imports into one searchable picker. Public source and the developer kit are available in [Hubble-Modules](https://github.com/Lightlab24/Hubble-Modules). - Module versions can be selected, pinned, and rolled back. Automatic module installation is off by default; when enabled, compatible stable updates apply at the next Hubble service startup. Beta versions remain a manual choice. - Main-matrix feedback appears faster across modules, including CCC camera enable/disable and destination selection. Editing and connection switches remain responsive while saves complete. - Workspace transfers preserve module settings and version policies. Previous module packages and configuration backups support upgrade recovery.
Ross routing now uses Ultrix OGP. Saved SW-P-08 configurations remain readable, but the retired SW-P-08 transport is unavailable; use an OGP connection for Ultrix.
The application update is optional. Existing service ports and configured addresses are retained; defaults remain 42837 for Companion and 42838 for HubDash.
